'''2018 US Nationals Day 2 Stephen Cellucci DS Senate Occupied''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Stephen Cellucci]] at [[2018 U.S. National Championship]] (Day 2).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Stephen Cellucci]]
* '''Event:''' [[2018 U.S. National Championship]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|My Lord, Is That Legal? / I Will Make It Legal|Cor-D-mylordisthatlegal.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
* '''Source:''' [https://www.starwarsccg.org/2018-us-nationals/ PC list]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20210127141216/https://www.starwarsccg.org/2018-us-nationals/ Internet Archive]
